questionEn: What fact on the topic “Chemical formula” is formulated without error?
questionUz: “Kimyoviy formula” mavzusida qanday fakt xatosiz tuzilgan?
choicesEn: The smallest particle of a substance that retains its chemical properties
A piece of metal of any size
choicesUz: Kimyoviy xossalarini saqlaydigan moddaning eng kichik zarrasi

explanationUz: Molekula - kimyoviy xossalariga ega bo'lgan moddaning zarrasi.
